column1: # The library repositories the performance pass measures from, and the package benches in them.
#   packages  comma-separated `name=subdir` for each library that carries its OWN bench
# `checkout_libs.sh` clones each one as a NORMAL checkout under $LOFT_PERF_LIBS (default: the
# directory `loft-bench-libs` beside this repository) and fast-forwards it when it is clean.
# These are the bench's OWN checkouts: a run writes build caches into them, which is why the
# pass never measures from a library author's working tree.
